notes.title: Playtest is live!
notes.notes:
The public playtest is now live. It is currently public and unlimited. My plan for the near future is to keep this playtest going for a while, as I update and fix the game.


You can take a look at the current state of the game, which as follows:

- the game has been verified to launch and play
- you start in the main menu with a character being played in the background by the computer, when you start the game, you take over the controls
- 3 bugs have been fixed already (only integrated AMD GPUs were affected)

Known issues/limitations:
- there is no character save implemented at the moment (and won't be for a while until there is enough game content to matter)
- full screen toggle crashes the game on integrated AMD GPUs if the resolution isn't set to the maximum screen resolution
- incorrect audio plays when the player loses the game (I've simply not yet implemented)


P.S. Expect frequent updates to the playtest.

notes.title: Playtest is coming soon!
notes.notes:
The first playtest is coming in the next few weeks. I am preparing an alpha build that will show the fundamentals of the game. You will get to control a heroine as she fights evil robots, while collecting new items and leveling up your attributes and skills.

My goal for the playtest is to test the game stability. I would love to hear to the feedback on the performance, lag and the feel of the game input. You can reach me on [url=https://discord.gg/olex]my Discord[/url] or post in the Steam community section.

Once the build is stable, more gameplay work will follow as I update the playtest for the near future.


Stay tuned for updates,
Olex @ Selfish Games
